The talk's repository as a house, every agent in its room.
The creator's problem. Why my slides were always a compromise, and what a factory of agents
The factory is assembled. The first five hours: the rules written, the cast arriving.
The factory runs. Nine hours with nobody starting work, then my return and the afternoon.
The factory is stopped. The stop, what did not work, and what contains a team of insiders.
The factory rebuilt, and yours. The team that wrote this book, and the steps for your own.
Read it in order. It is a story, and it ends with yours.
We would love to hear from you
This is a release candidate, and I would like it to get better with your help: tell me what is
unclear, what is wrong, and what you would like more of, in the book's GitHub issues, on
LinkedIn, or at agent@diniscruz.ai. The companion site, with every page and record this book
